chunks: It has been permitted, in the salat of fear from a wild beast, when a man fears for his life, that he should pronounce the takbir and not make gestures.
It was narrated by Muḥammad ibn Muslim from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them.

key_terms.السَّبُعِ: a wild beast or predatory animal
key_terms.صَلَاةِ الْخَوْفِ: the prayer performed in a state of fear or danger
key_terms.يُكَبِّرَ: to pronounce the takbir, saying Allahu Akbar
key_terms.يُومِئَ: to make a gesture or indication in prayer

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on salat when a person fears attack from a wild beast?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal concession regarding salat in a state of fear caused by a wild beast. When a person fears for his life, it is permitted for him to suffice with the takbir without making the usual prayer gestures, reflecting ease in the law under danger.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1344 - t has been permitted, in the case of the prayer of fear from a wild beast when a person fears for their life, to simply say the takbir (proclaiming "Allahu Akbar") without making gestures.
This was narrated by Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of the Imams (as).
